body.message: Got your email, Jeremie. Yes, Binghatti Azure has both a pool and gym. Monthly rental is available, minimum stay is 1 month, no 30-day notice needed, just confirm 10 days before if you want to extend, and early checkout is non-refundable. Parking isn't included as standard but can be arranged, and yes, a contract is issued in your name. Passport copy and you're all set for Tuesday the 30th, want me to get that confirmed now?
